stories.title_he: ההעברה התקציבית אושרה בישיבת לילה לאחר הודעת ביטול
stories.title_en: Budget transfer approved at a 3am sitting reconvened after a cancellation notice
stories.summary_en: The finance committee approved a contested budget transfer by a single vote at approximately 03:00, at a sitting reconvened roughly an hour after members were notified it had been cancelled. Three members say they were never told it was back on.

stories.title_he: התוכנית החדשה לדיור הוצגה עם הדמיות משנת 2019
stories.title_en: New housing plan presented with renderings recycled from 2019
stories.summary_en: The ministry presented a national housing plan in which three of five architectural renderings had already appeared in a 2019 announcement. The ministry has not disputed the identification.
